header: I prepare an announcement for the search bar the way a circular is prepared, in two PARTS that can each be redone alone:
* THE BODY: the announcement's own text is cut into 200-word passages (the circulars' chunking, src/lib/ingestion/chunking.ts), each with a vector (source 'body').

* THE PDF: read page by page (reader.ts): a true PDF from its own text layer, a page without a usable one (a scan, an infographic) by Gemini, as a circular's pages are; the picture of every page is kept in storage (as circulars keep theirs); the text is cut into 200-word passages per page, each with a vector (source 'pdf'); the whole text is kept.

Then I make the announcement's own vector again from title, body and the start of the PDF's text (embedAnnouncement), as a circular's whole-document vector is. MY RULES (the circulars' own, and no more lenient):

* I make ALL vectors BEFORE anything is written: if a passage's vector cannot be made, that part is not saved at all (I never store an unsearchable passage and call it a success); the failure is recorded with its reason, and the manager can index it again.

* Page pictures go into storage before the database write and are TRACKED: if the part then fails, I take them out again; the pictures of what it replaces are taken out after the commit. A failure leaves no trace.
* A page that cannot be read is named in the note; the pages that were read are kept. If NO page has text, it is a failure.
* It never throws: publishing or editing an announcement must not fail because its text or PDF could not be prepared. The answer says what happened.
* At most MAX_PAGES pages are read (the time of one request); a longer PDF is prepared up to there and the note says so.
Everything outside the logic (page reading, embedding, storage, database, clock) is injected, so it can be tested without network access.

symbols.name: MAX_PAGES
doc: The most pages I read from one PDF, to limit the time and cost of one request.

symbols.name: READ_BUDGET_MS
doc: The time I allow for reading the pages, counted from the start of the request.

members.name: text
doc: Text of the page; I use "" when none could be had.

members.name: via
doc: Where the text came from: the PDF's own text, AI reading, or nowhere.

members.name: reason
doc: Why a page has no text, or only part of it.

members.name: pages
doc: The pages that were read, in order (index 0 = page 1).

members.name: images
doc: The picture (PNG) of each page, by the same index; null where it could not be drawn.

members.name: totalPages
doc: The PDF has this many pages in all; this is more than were read when it exceeds MAX_PAGES.

members.name: read
doc: Reads the PDF page by page; the real one is reader.ts.

members.name: embed
doc: Gives one vector for one text (a stored document: RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT), already normalised.

members.name: reEmbedRecord
doc: Makes the announcement's own vector again once its parts are saved (embedAnnouncement).

members.name: storage
doc: Where I keep the page pictures.
